page.layout: One printed title page, full width: decorative border around the text; title block centred at top, imprint lines below a rule, woodcut ornament in the middle, imprint lines at the foot. Handwritten annotations, library stamps (Paris and Honoré seals), and a manuscript shelf mark are not printed text and are left out.

main_text.l: Anno nati Christi M. DC. XLI.

page.notes: The handwritten Latin motto ("Studeo Veritati Non Opinioni...", "Nolim Magister esse Opinionis sed fidei...") and the marginal manuscript notes are not printed and are omitted. The printed name at the imprint line "Dublinij" is read as printed. The printer's imprint line in the left lower area is partly obscured by handwriting, so it is given as the clearly legible printed text only.
